name: Replogle et al. 2022 Core p53 Circuit (K562 / RPE1)

provenance.name: Replogle et al. 2022 Core p53 DNA Damage Circuit (K562 vs. RPE1)
provenance.technology: Genome-scale single-cell CRISPR interference (CRISPRi dCas9-KRAB) with high-throughput scRNA-seq
provenance.data_type: Log2 fold-change in single-cell expression following CRISPRi repression of target regulators
provenance.perturbation_type: CRISPRi transcriptional repression (dCas9-KRAB targeted to transcription start sites)
cell_lines: K562 (human chronic myeloid leukemia, TP53 mutant)
RPE1 (human hTERT retinal pigment epithelial, TP53 wild-type)
citations: Replogle, J. M., Saunders, R. A., Pogson, A. N., Hussmann, J. A., et al. (2022). Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq. Cell, 185(14), 2559-2575. DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2022.05.013
provenance.overview: Replogle et al. established genome-scale Perturb-seq across essential human cell cycle checkpoints. This 12-gene circuit captures the core p53 tumor suppressor checkpoint, including ATM/CHEK2 DNA damage sensing, CDKN1A/p21 cyclin-dependent kinase inhibition, MDM2 feedback, and RB1/E2F1 cell-cycle gatekeeping across two distinct genetic backgrounds: TP53-deficient K562 and TP53-competent RPE1.

genes_annotated.TP53: Tumor protein p53; master tumor suppressor and stress response transcription factor.
genes_annotated.CDKN1A: p21/CIP1; cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor blocking CDK2/CDK4 to enforce G1/S cell cycle arrest.
genes_annotated.MDM2: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase MDM2; negative feedback inhibitor promoting p53 proteasomal degradation.
genes_annotated.ATM: ATM serine/threonine kinase; primary sensor of DNA double-strand breaks activating p53 and CHEK2.
genes_annotated.CHEK1: Checkpoint kinase 1; downstream effector of ATR mediating intra-S and G2/M arrest.
genes_annotated.CHEK2: Checkpoint kinase 2; ATM-activated kinase that phosphorylates p53 at Ser20 to block MDM2 binding.
genes_annotated.BAX: BCL2-associated X protein; pro-apoptotic pore-forming effector downstream of p53 in mitochondrial apoptosis.
genes_annotated.BBC3: PUMA (p53 upregulated modulator of apoptosis); BH3-only pro-apoptotic protein.
genes_annotated.GADD45A: Growth arrest and DNA damage-inducible alpha; mediates G2/M arrest and nucleotide excision repair.
genes_annotated.E2F1: E2F transcription factor 1; master G1/S transition activator repressed by unphosphorylated RB1.
genes_annotated.RB1: Retinoblastoma protein 1; master cell cycle gatekeeper repressing E2F1 until hyperphosphorylated by CDKs.
genes_annotated.CCNE1: Cyclin E1; regulatory subunit of CDK2 promoting G1/S phase progression and RB1 phosphorylation.

provenance.wrangling_procedure:
1. Single-cell UMI counts filtered to cells with verified CRISPRi sgRNA protospacers against the 12 core checkpoint genes.
2. Total count depth normalization and log1p transformation.
3. Median expression shifts computed relative to non-targeting control guides.
4. Assembled into steady-state response matrix X measuring target knockdown (80-90% repression) and downstream cascades.

how_raw_data_is_used.wrangled_direct: The 12-gene CRISPRi knockdown matrix X and perturbation matrix U are consumed directly to benchmark algorithm ability to reconstruct the canonical TP53 -> CDKN1A -| CCNE1 -> RB1 pathway across mutant vs wild-type backgrounds.
how_raw_data_is_used.biophysical_fit: Parameters (v_i, b_i, K_ij, n) are estimated to capture non-linear cell-cycle bistability and compare how loss of TP53 decouples DNA damage sensing from apoptotic induction.
